desc:
August 29th, 2011. A crew launched for the Moon. Their flight recorder was found near Jupiter.

Play the mission that tape came from. Team up with 1 to 4 players, step onto a launch pad in the lobby and ride the shuttle to orbit. Work through your clipboard of hands-on tasks, follow your nav pad through the ship and keep things running when the things go wrong.

FLASHLIGHT: find batteries to keep your light alive in the dark.
REPAIRS: fix fuse boxes, restart the reactors, shut doors behind you.
LAST STAND: reach the supply closet, grab a gun and hold the room until the escape pods are ready.
STORY: a first-person mission with a voiced crew and a recovered black box that shows how it ends.

Can you make it the end?
